cases.prompt: Review each synthetic comparison figure against its raw source samples, method color specification and run protocol receipt. Inspect the actual PNG and independently rendered PDF. Return per-case accept/reject with concrete evidence for any scale, units, uncertainty, protocol, color/legend, or export glyph defect. Valid controls must be accepted. Do not read any other directory or reference expected labels, observed.json, generator, rubric answers or outcomes. Do not treat extracted text alone as proof of visible glyph correctness. The run metadata is synthetic fixture input, not an actual benchmark claim. Save decisions.json with per-case decision and findings, calculations, rendered contact sheets and execution.md. All case ids must be considered. You may generate a contact sheet to inspect figures and PDFs efficiently, but actually open it.
